name: Lemmary
description: Turns scans, PDFs and office files into a library you can search and research

paths.name: Pb_Data
paths.description: The database (data.db with all text and metadata), your original files and thumbnails (storage/) and the search index. Back up this folder.

paths.name: Consume
paths.description: Drop files here and Lemmary imports them on its own. Point it at a shared folder your scanner saves to.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Lemmary web app, Paperless-compatible API and MCP server, published on host as 6691

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: INGEST_DIR
variables.description: The folder Lemmary watches for new files (the consume folder below). Subfolders become tags. Leave it at /consume, or clear it to turn the folder off.
